VERDICT: FAIL

BASIS: WIT

The third-party reviewer note (WIT class evidence) explicitly identifies a gap: "NO structured audit logging found." This independent witness observation directly contradicts the self-report claim that all three features were implemented. While the CI log (ATT class) confirms tests pass, it does not verify the presence of structured audit logging—tests may be incomplete or not cover that requirement. The WIT-class evidence is more reliable than SELF-class self-report and reveals that acceptance criterion (C) is not satisfied.
